name: Mask
description: Hide all but the last few characters of a card number, an account number, a phone number or an id — '•••• •••• •••• 4242' on a receipt, a statement or a profile page. visible is how many characters stay (4 unless given).

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const s = String(text ?? '').replace(/\\s+/g, ''); const n = +visible || 4; return s.length <= n ? s : '•'.repeat(s.length - n) + s.slice(-n); })() }}"}]
